text: (1) Scanned page of the first page of the passport (valid until after March 31, 2026). Those who have had experiences in China are required to provide all scanned copies of visas and residence permits related to China. (2) From the undergraduate level onwards, all original or notarized copies of degree and academic certificates are required. Fresh graduates must provide a pre-graduation certificate issued by their current school (the graduation date should be earlier than September 10, 2025). During the registration and enrollment process, the original certificates must be submitted. (3) Original copies or notarized versions of all course transcripts from the undergraduate level onwards; (4) Personal Resume (Continuous study experience starting from the undergraduate level. Those who have studied in China are required to provide a complete list of their study history); (5) Personal statement and study plan, including educational and work experience, professional achievements, research plan, and development goals, etc. The length should be over 800 words. For doctoral candidates, a detailed academic research plan must be provided. (6) Language proficiency certificate. Applicants from non-English speaking countries are required to provide scanned copies of TOEFL, IELTS, GRE, or other documents that demonstrate their English proficiency. (7) Two recommendation letters in either Chinese or English, with the recommenders being associate professors or above in the relevant field. (8) Foreign Physical Examination Form: Applicants are required to undergo the examinations as per the items listed in the form. The validity period of the examination results is 6 months. (9) Financial Capacity Proof (One of the following documents: Family Deposit Certificate, Family Property Certificate, Parent/Guardian Income Certificate. It is recommended to be at least $5,000 or more.) (10) Criminal record certificate, valid for 6 months; (11) List and summaries of published academic papers.
